{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Blouse: relaxed fit with a soft V-neck and three-quarter sleeves, hip-skimming length, warm ivory (#E8DFD0), matte crepe.
Trousers: high-waisted, straight leg, full length to the ankle bone, deep charcoal (#3A3D42), fine wool blend with a slight drape.
Jacket: single-breasted, straight cut, hip length, one-button, soft shoulder, dark espresso brown (#4A3B32), textured wool bouclé tweed.
Loafers: classic almond toe, low block heel, dark chocolate (#2B1E18), smooth leather.
Belt: slim, with a small matte gold buckle, dark chocolate (#2B1E18), smooth leather.
Earrings: small round studs, muted antique gold (#B08D57), polished metal.
Bag: structured medium tote with a top handle, deep charcoal (#3A3D42), pebbled leather.

Why this outfit works: The palette is quiet and tonal, built from ivory, charcoal and espresso, so nothing is bright and the look stays restrained, as you wanted. The warm ivory blouse sits close to your face and complements your deep skin and dark hair, while the darker jacket and trousers give a clean, grounded line. The tweed texture adds autumn depth without fuss. Three-quarter sleeves are the one open zone, and with the straight trousers and loafers the whole look is neat, comfortable and right for a day at the office."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2362,"output_tokens":999},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
